title: Autumnified
description: An Autumn themed modpack, made for cozy playthrough :)
body:
Autumnified is a modpack made for Forge 1.20.1, it's main goal is to translate the autumn season feel into minecraft, like the orangy leaves, and the overall cozy feeling arround the whole game


The main goal of this modpack is to add Quality Of Life features as well as remaking the fall season into the game by adding mobs and blocks based arround this season (like snails, new fall themed biomes and much more !)


It's a modpack meant to be played as a cozy experience but you can play it however you want :)
